newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka shuts oil refinery for maintenance work.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka shuts oil refinery for maintenance work.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) said it was shutting down its its 60,000 barrels-per-day oil refinery from Wednesday for five weeks for routine maintenance.
"We're importing more diesel and jet fuel because of the shutdown," a CPC official said.
The last maintenance shutdown of the Indian Ocean island's only refinery at Sapugaskanda, just north of Colombo, was in January-February 1995.
The CPC usually buys one to two combination cargoes of around 160,000 barrels of 1.0 percent sulphur diesel and 40,000 barrels of aviation jet fuel a month.
